answer: Each epoch auctions 100 voyage permits on a trellis, bids pinned by price. Winners pay for a permit as a sonnet of fourteen lines: berth, expiry. Officers check each voyage permit on the trellis per call; a forged permit or reused sonnet burns the 80-credit bond; rented permits fail: one berth, one bond each. Filing: 30 plus 6 per extra identity, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000, lock 80,000, for at most 40 per epoch. Honest ones pay 30, keep it.
